eventName: 6th Annual One Lakh Palm Seed plantation-10th week field work
eventDescription:
Vidhaigal Organization, in association with Adhiparasakthi Agricultural College and Don Bosco Agricultural College, planted 1,000 palm seeds along the banks of the Melthangai water catchment area at Nathanallur 
Every day is a day to sow seeds!
Let us keep planting?
Let us continue protecting nature?
